message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s). Facts: a village committee deputy director uses his position to fill false application for rural dilapidated house reconstruction, obtains subsidy 16000 RMB. This is fraud using official position. Likely crime: "诈骗" (fraud) or "职务侵占"? Under Chinese criminal law, using position to obtain public funds by false statements is "诈骗罪" (fraud) or "职务侵占罪" (embezzlement of public funds). The description: "利用职务上的便利，通过填报虚假危房改造申请材料的方式骗取危房改造补助款". This is typical of "诈骗罪" (fraud) but also "职务侵占罪" is for misappropriation of public property by a state employee. However, the act is submitting false application, not misappropriating already entrusted funds. So likely "诈骗罪". The correction rule: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "诈骗". If multiple, separate with semicolons. Here only one.

Thus final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
